SELECT
    [Id] AS db_requestId,
    [Version] AS db_version,
    [InstructionId] AS db_instructionId,
    [AccountId] AS db_accountId,
    [RailType] AS db_railType,
    [Amount] AS db_amount,
    [RequestType] AS db_requestType,
    [Status] AS db_status,
    [CreatedDate] AS db_createdDate,
    [UpdatedDate] AS db_updatedDate
FROM [dbo].[MoneyMovementRequest]
WHERE [Id] = '{{requestId}}'
